Note the last line: istio-proxy "Failed to create grpc connection to probe app: context deadline exceeded" — that's just probe.

Checkoutservice's error said "failed to charge card: charge card error". Where does "charge card error" come from? In the boutique checkoutservice Go code, there's a function chargeCard / quoteShipping. Actually in the microservices-demo checkoutservice, `chargeCard` returns error wrapped: "failed to charge card: %+v". The underlying error from payment. If payment call itself returned error... but paymentservice logs show successful transactions.

Hmm, but maybe the actual charge calls from checkoutservice fail because of address (env var)? No — paymentservice logs show charges happening every moment, so charges succeed.
